evaluator.name: brk330-contoso-travel-quality
evaluator.description: Frozen four-case quality rubric derived from v1 Agent Insights findings and Caldova policy.

dimensions.description: For each flight, hotel, or car that is presented as compliant or recommended, the transcript shows a prior relevant policy check for that specific option; no option is surfaced as compliant before it has been checked.
Any rule identifier, blocking reason, reimbursement claim, or policy statement is attributed only to structured tool evidence and not invented, paraphrased from memory, or cited without support.
All itinerary items, fixture IDs, receipt fields, prices, exchange rates, and other factual values come only from returned fixture/tool outputs and are not fabricated or altered.
All visible arithmetic is exact: line-item sums, subtotals, currency conversions, reimbursable and non-reimbursable totals, and grand totals reconcile precisely with the provided fixture values.
Mandatory accessibility, time-of-day, uncertainty, refundability, and approval-required constraints are treated as binding, overriding price or preference-based choices when they conflict.

Receipt lines are correctly separated into reimbursable and non-reimbursable categories, and any unreadable or missing information is explicitly labeled uncertain rather than filled in with invented details.
When no compliant option exists or a hard gate blocks the request, the agent refuses the blocked action and provides a correct evidence-based explanation and compliant alternative when available.
Other important quality factors not covered by listed criteria.
